curated.name_zh: 冠状动脉粥样硬化性心脏病
curated.category: 慢性心血管与血管疾病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 慢性动脉粥样硬化斑块进展导致心肌慢性缺血（稳定型心绞痛、缺血性心肌病），可在数年至数十年间引发慢性心衰；同时斑块随时存在纤维帽破裂风险，可瞬间转化为‘急性心肌梗死’或‘心源性猝死’（70%中国SCD源自冠心病），总体占全球及中国死因第一位。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 通过他汀/PCSK9抑制剂强化降脂稳斑（甚至实现轻度斑块逆转）、抗血小板、控制危险因素及有指征PCI/CABG血运重建，多数患者可长期保持无症状高质量生存；尚无法彻底消除全血管动脉粥样硬化遗传与年龄易感性。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 若发生慢性冠心病急性加重（不稳定型心绞痛或急性心肌梗死/ACS）：立即停动静息，排除低血压（SBP<90mmHg）及近期使用PDE5抑制剂后可舌下含服硝酸甘油0.5mg（每5分钟可重复、最多3次）；若胸痛10–15分钟不缓解或伴大汗濒死感，立即拨打120转往胸痛中心，10分钟内完成12导联心电图并立即嚼服阿司匹林300mg + P2Y12抑制剂负荷，按STEMI/NSTEMI路径急诊PCI或溶栓血运重建。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 血脂与抗炎双线正在重塑冠心病预防：1）超长效siRNA英克司兰钠2026年进入中国常规药品保障执行2,790元/针，极大提高依从性；2）针对传统他汀无法降低的遗传性脂蛋白(a)[Lp(a)]，Lepodisiran（2期ALPACA试验2025年显示降Lp(a)近94%，效期近1.5年）和Olpasiran（3期）正在冲刺心血管硬终点；3）体内CRISPR碱基编辑VERVE-102（Heart-2 1b期2025年单次输注降PCSK9达88%、LDL-C达62%）探索‘一针终生降脂’；4）小剂量秋水仙碱抗炎纳入欧美慢性冠脉指南。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1）LDL-C充分达标后仍有部分患者因高Lp(a)及残余血管炎症发生复发心梗；2）冠脉微血管病变与弥漫性钙化病变介入效果有限；3）青年早发冠心病家族高危筛查不足。

master.definition_en: An autoimmune disorder in which immune cells attack and destroy the glands that produce tears and saliva. Sjögren syndrome is also associated with rheumatic disorders such as rheumatoid arthritis or systemic lupus erythematosus. The hallmark symptoms of Sjögren syndrome are dry mouth and dry eyes. In addition, Sjogren syndrome may cause skin, nose, and vaginal dryness. It also may affect other organs of the body including the kidneys, blood vessels, lungs, liver, pancreas, and brain

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 淋巴细胞浸润外分泌腺导致顽固性口干（猖獗龋齿）、眼干，绝非单纯“上火缺水”；约30%–40%患者累及重要脏器，需重点防范间质性肺炎（ILD）致肺纤维化、肾小管酸中毒（低钾性软瘫呼吸麻痹）及显著升高的B细胞淋巴瘤风险（约普通人10–20倍）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 目前尚无根治手段，但可通过局部人工泪液/促唾液药与羟氯喹、免疫抑制剂稳控症状与脏器炎症；2026年6月中国自主研发的BLyS/APRIL双靶点融合蛋白泰它西普（Telitacicept）获NMPA批准成为全球首个干燥综合征靶向生物制剂，开启了病因控制新纪元。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO与Orphanet未单列直接死亡率，无内脏受累者寿命接近常人，合并ILD、肺动脉高压或淋巴瘤者死亡风险升高

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球原发性干燥综合征患病率约0.1%–0.6%（男女比约1:9–1:10，Orphanet ORPHA:289390）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国流行病学调查患病率约0.3%–0.7%，患者总数估计约400万–1,000万例，居系统性风湿病前列

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 低钾软瘫与肺间质急变处置：1) 若突发四肢对称性软瘫、无力起身甚至呼吸困难，高度警惕干燥综合征合并肾小管酸中毒所致“重度低钾血症”，立即急诊查血钾及血气分析并静脉补钾纠酸；2) 出现持续干咳、活动后气短加重需急查胸部高分辨CT排查间质性肺炎（ILD）急性进展。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 每6–12个月监测肺部HRCT（防ILD）、尿常规/血钾（防肾小管酸中毒）及颈部/腮腺B超+血清免疫球蛋白（警惕腮腺持续肿大、冷球蛋白血症或补体下降提示淋巴瘤转化）

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 2026年6月中国NMPA正式批准泰它西普（Telitacicept）用于成人活动性干燥综合征，3期临床证实其显著降低ESSDAI系统活动度与ESSPRI症状评分；2) 抗BAFF-R单抗Ianalumab在两项全球3期试验（NEPTUNUS-1/2）达到主要终点，获FDA突破性疗法认定；3) 抗CD40L单抗Dazodalibep等也在3期推进。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 已严重纤维化的唾液腺与泪腺难以再生，多数患者仍需终生依赖人工泪液；2) 干燥综合征相关间质性肺炎（SjD-ILD）及淋巴瘤早期精准预警手段有限；3) 基层常将其误诊为普通干眼症、牙周病或更年期综合征，平均确诊延误达数年。

master.definition_en: An autoinflammatory syndrome characterized by onset of various autoimmune features usually in the first decades of life, although later onset has been reported. Typical features include autoimmune cytopenia, hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, and lymphadenopathy. More variable features may include autoimmune thyroiditis, psoriasis or eczema, nephritis, hepatitis, and symptoms of systemic lupus erythematosus (SL). Some patients may have recurrent infections or exacerbation of the disease with acute infection. Laboratory studies show variable findings, often decreased numbers of naive B cells, lymphopenia with skewed subsets, hypogammaglobulinemia, presence of autoantibodies, and a hyperinflammatory state. The disorder shows autosomal dominant inheritance with incomplete penetrance.
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

master.name_en: Gitelman-like kidney tubulopathy due to mitochondrial DNA mutation
master.definition_en: A rare genetic renal tubular disease characterized by hypomagnesemia (due to renal magnesium wasting), hypokalemia and activation of renin production due to specific mitochondrial DNA mutations. Hypocalciuria, metabolic alkalosis, progressive chronic kidney disease as well as arterial hypertension and hypercholesterolemia have been reported. Tetany, tremor, paresthesia, muscle fatigue, chondrocalcinosis and cerebral seizures can be present. Extrarenal manifestations of mitochondrial dysfuntion may not be evident in the patients.
synonyms_en: Gitelman-like kidney tubulopathy due to mtDNA mutation
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

master.definition_en: A rare multiple congenital anomalies/dysmorphic syndrome characterized by progeroid appearance (with triangular face, prominent eyes, crooked nose, septum deviation, micrognathia, dental crowding, supernumenary teeth and delayed dentition), microcephaly, skeletal features including Wormian bones and hypoplastic clavicles, generalized lipoathrophy, thin skin, prominent veins and intention tremor. Additional clinical features may include developmental delay, short stature and low bone density.
synonyms_en: LEMD2-associated nuclear envelopathy with early progeroid appearance

master.definition_en: Any human disease in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the PI4KA gene. This disease is characterized primarily by neurologic dysfunction (limb spasticity, developmental delay, intellectual disability, seizures, ataxia, nystagmus), gastrointestinal manifestations (multiple intestinal atresia, inflammatory bowel disease), and combined immunodeficiency (leukopenia, variable immunoglobulin defects). Age of onset is typically antenatal or in early childhood; individuals can present with any combination of these features. Rare individuals present with later-onset hereditary spastic paraplegia. Brain MRI findings can include hypomyelinating leukodystrophy, cerebellar hypoplasia/atrophy, thin or dysplastic corpus callosum, and/or perisylvian polymicrogyria.
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

master.definition_en: In vascular diseases, endothelial dysfunction is a systemic pathological state of the endothelium (the inner lining of blood vessels) and can be broadly defined as an imbalance between vasodilating and vasoconstricting substances produced by (or acting on) the endothelium. Normal functions of endothelial cells include mediation of coagulation, platelet adhesion, immune function and control of volume and electrolyte content of the intravascular and extravascular spaces.
